numbers.label: Chinese models' share of token usage on OpenRouter by September
numbers.context: As counted by Michael Spencer, Oct 1, 2026; Le Shrub had 66% on Sep 22

mentions.excerpt: Le Shrub had Chinese models at 66% of token share on September 22.
Spencer conceded on September 11 that the Chinese labs' share of token spending remains to be seen; Le Shrub's 66% answered him on volume; the dollar share is still uncounted.
Spencer reported on September 16 that OpenAI had delayed its listing until next year; Le Shrub, on September 22, relayed Alex Karp's view that OpenAI will never list.

sides.claim: China is gaining ground in AI, with Chinese models now accounting for 66% of token share.
